data class [WordInfo](index.html)(val word: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val startOffset: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val endOffset: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null)

A single transcribed word and where it falls in the audio.

Populated only when word-level timestamps are requested via [AudioTranscriptionConfig.wordTimestamp](../-audio-transcription-config/word-timestamp.html).
